text:
Lamps in a circuit are connected in parallel.
What is the advantage of this?
A
If one lamp breaks, the others remain lit.
B
Less current is taken from the power supply.
C
The lamps use less power than if they were connected in series.
D
The potential difference across each lamp is less than that of the power supply.
